## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Ruff, Mypy, pytest with coverage, and dependency audit pass
- [ ] Package/container smoke tests pass where applicable
- [ ] Restore or migration behavior was considered

## Security and operations

- [ ] No credentials, private metadata, repository names, or backup data are included
- [ ] Least-privilege/token implications are documented
- [ ] Storage, retention, logging, and compatibility implications are documented

## Release note

Use a Conventional Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, and so on). Note any breaking change
explicitly.
